title: Fungoidite
body:
Description

Fungoidite is one of the many nodes that can spawn on Ferwater Island. These nodes can only be found in Uncertainty Cave.

Fungoidite's appearance can be charactized by having purple streaks that traverse the dark material of the stone. The refined version appears to have purple-hued layering slabs, and the forged version of this node can be described to having a texture reminiscent of bismuth, albeit purple.

The chart below displays all possible ores that spawn within this node.

Fungiviolet 3/500 chance spawn. Fungoidite exclusive

Trivia

  • The translational string for Fungoidite in the game files is "fun_rock"
